notes.title: Announcing Free Bugsnax VR Update & Sale!
notes.notes:
[h1]To celebrate 4 years since Bugsnax’s launch, we’re releasing VR on SteamVR for Windows as a free update for all of you.[/h1] 

[u]For those who own the game on other platforms or have never given Bugsnax a shot, we hope 60% off until 11/15 will mean you join us on Snaktooth Island! [/u] 

What began as a fun side project by one of our programmers has evolved into a free update for Bugsnax fans! Converting the game from flatscreen to VR felt like a natural fit, especially with the hands-on use of tools and traps that make catching Bugsnax so engaging. Plus, you can now compare your height with all the Grumpus characters. Hint: they’re taller than you think! 

Thank you to everyone who participated in our open beta and gave feedback and feature requests! It’s been awesome getting to hear from the VR community and introduce more of you to our goofy game. Fans have been asking for Bugsnax in VR since it launched, and at long last, you can now pet a Bunger up close and personal, in virtual reality.

While you’re here, we’ve also just opened shop for Bugsnax: The Card Game. If you’re a Bugsnax fan (or your kids are), you can now buy a physical copy of the game and have it shipped pretty much anywhere in the world. [url=bugsnaxcardgame.com]Show me the cards[/url]. 

Thanks for 4 incredible years and for loving our games as much as we love to make them

-The Young Horses


[h2]For the full FAQ and other useful information on Bugsnax VR, check our pinned thread in the Discussions tab of the Community Hub![/h2]

notes.title: Update 2.0.64433 (5/1/2022)
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*]Removed Uncapped FPS for now as there are too many small physics issues with the 120hz physics timestep that can prevent completing parts of the game.
[*] Improved Snakgrappler.
[*] Added contingency for Snorpy not reaching his spot in Major Celebration.
[*] Fixed Cheddorb respawn issue and improved Cheddorb movement/forces. 
[*] Improved Buggy Ball to prevent spinning in a circle forever if retargeting or clearing autopilot.
[*] Added workaround for Intel Surface Pro GPU hang/crash on DX11 using default Windows driver. If using an Intel driver on first launch the game will now switch to DX9 instead of DX11 which does not have issues. If you are currently having crashes on an Intel cpu please switch to DX9 in Settings->Display or update your Intel driver from the Intel website to latest instead of Windows supplied driver (may cause other issues on Surface Pro though).
[*] Fixed rendering issue with frozen Pinkle.
[*] Improved Falling mail challenge.
[*] Fixed collision issues allowing you to leave level while in The Intruder sequence.

[/olist]
